verdict.rationale: Unleash documents an official first-party MCP server that lets LLM-powered coding assistants create and manage feature flags, so users can operate the product with natural language through an external AI client. There is no evidence of a native natural-language interface in the Admin UI, and the MCP scope is described only as flag creation and management. Missing for 10: native in-product natural-language command interface, documented coverage of operations beyond flag creation/management (e.g., rollouts, segments, change requests), independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP workflow.
